At the core of GMG ColorServer is GMG’s MX technology, built to deliver highly accurate color conversion and optimization for CMYK, RGB, ECG, and multicolor files. It prepares print-ready files quickly while preserving the black channel and stabilizing sensitive color areas, helping maintain better image quality and more consistent color reproduction compared to standard conversion methods.

Brand colors often need to be reproduced across different printing technologies where ink sets may vary. GMG ColorServer automatically converts spot colors into the required output color space, whether using standard CMYK or extended gamuts such as CMYKOGV, helping ensure brand colors remain accurate and consistent across every print job.

Powerful and Automated Processing

name: Autura™ Ink Software
shortDescription: For Ink Formulation and Quality Control
overview:
### Autura™ Ink Software

### Ink Innovation Begins with Autura Ink

Speed up ink development with Autura Ink, a comprehensive formulation and quality control solution for ink suppliers, printers, and converters. As a cloud-based platform, Autura Ink can be accessed from anywhere and brings formulation, storage, approval, retrieval, and quality control into one place. It supports offset, flexo, gravure, and screen-printing inks, giving teams a single platform to manage their formulation and quality control needs.

### Identify Ink Colour Variations Quickly

Colour mismatches can bring a press to a standstill and quickly add to production costs. BestMatch gives operators a clearer way to assess what is causing the variation and choose the appropriate correction. They can determine whether changing film thickness, viscosity, or press settings will bring the colour into range, or whether the formulation needs to be adjusted instead. This makes it easier to resolve colour issues and get the press back to normal operation sooner.

### Keep Presses Running with Quick Correction

When an on-press colour does not meet specification, Autura's Quick Correction feature helps determine the ink formula additions needed to bring the colour back on target. This helps operators resolve colour issues and resume production quickly

### Create Consistent Ink Formulation Templates

Autura Ink gives teams a structured way to handle different customer formulation needs. Predefined settings can be saved in templates for specific use cases, making it easier for new staff to get up to speed and helping reduce expensive formulation errors. With a consistent process in place, teams can improve productivity and achieve more repeatable results across their formulations.

### Automatically Detect and Correct Bronzing

Bronzing can be addressed before it becomes a production issue with Autura Ink. Its IFS 7.0 formulation engine identifies bronzing anomalies as recipes are developed and automatically makes the necessary corrections. Built into the Autura Desktop Assortment Builder, the feature helps keep ink data bronzing-proof from the outset, while reducing waste and costly defects and supporting consistent print quality.

Improve Operational Efficiency

Autura provides a centralised platform that gives all users access to the same up-to-date version, anytime and anywhere.

Secure Cloud-Based Ink Management

Autura's cloud-based technology helps keep your data secure while requiring minimal local IT support.

Manage Ink Assortments Efficiently

Autura's assortment views make it easier to manage ink assortments while eliminating redundancy.
keyFeatures: Secure, serverless cloud-native platform
Formulation and QC combined in a workflow-driven interface
Best-in-class colour matching with smart assortment creation

GMG OpenColor uses patented conversion technology to create highly accurate color simulations without relying on test charts. ### Optimized Proofing for the Packaging Market

Powered by the new GMG Spectral MX Color Engine, the software delivers major performance improvements with proof profile calculation up to 15 times faster, improved profile quality, and profile sizes up to 90% smaller. It integrates with systems such as MeasureColor from X-Rite, while leading PDF editors like PACKZ from Hybrid Software also rely on its color management technology.

GMG OpenColor creates both proof profiles and separation profiles that integrate directly with GMG ColorServer and GMG ColorPlugin. name: Universal Friction Tester (UFT)
shortDescription: A friction testing system designed to measure static and dynamic friction for packaging and material testing.
overview:
### Universal Friction Tester (UFT)

A friction testing system designed to measure static and dynamic friction for packaging and material testing.

### Accurate Slip & Friction Testing for Packaging Materials

The Universal Friction Tester (UFT) is designed to measure the slip resistance of materials by determining static and dynamic coefficient of friction values. It helps manufacturers predict product feeding, handling, and running performance on automated gluing, erecting, filling, and packaging lines.

### Why Slip & Friction Testing Matters

Surface friction directly affects how packaging materials move during printing, conversion, and automated packaging processes. Materials with very low friction may slide apart during handling, while higher friction materials can stick together and cause misfeeds, making friction testing essential for maintaining efficient production speeds.

### Static & Dynamic Coefficient of Friction Measurement

The UFT measures both Static COF (Fs/N) and Dynamic COF (Fd/N), where static friction represents the force required to start movement between two surfaces, while dynamic friction measures the force needed to maintain movement once the initial resistance is overcome. These values are typically expressed as decimal ratios between 0 and 1.

### Advanced Testing Features for Repeatable Results

The instrument uses automatic sled placement with variable dwell time control to ensure highly repeatable static COF measurements independent of the operator. A fixed mechanical link between the sled and load cell eliminates measurement errors commonly caused by pulley wheels or cords found in conventional friction testing systems.

### User-Friendly Operation & Quality Control Testing

The UFT features an intuitive touch screen interface that allows easy operation with minimal training. It includes pre-loaded ISO, ASTM, and standard friction testing methods, while also allowing users to create custom testing procedures for quality assurance and specialized testing requirements.

Precise COF Measurement

Measures both static and dynamic coefficients of friction with high repeatability.

Automated Test Control

Automatic sled placement and dwell time control improve consistency and reduce operator influence.

Multiple Testing Applications

Supports friction testing along with peel, tear, and seal integrity testing across various packaging materials.

shortDescription: Precision thickness measurement instrument designed for fast, accurate, and repeatable thickness testing of films, paper, board, plastics, textiles, and other flexible materials.
overview:
### Hanatek Precision Thickness Gauge (FT3)

Precision thickness measurement instrument designed for fast, accurate, and repeatable thickness testing of films, paper, board, plastics, textiles, and other flexible materials.

### Why Thickness Measurement Matters

Accurate thickness measurement helps improve product quality while controlling raw material costs. Thickness directly affects properties such as strength, stiffness, puncture resistance, WVTR, CO₂ and O₂ transmission, haze, and opacity, making it an important quality parameter across many industries. It also helps reduce waste, rework, recycling, and replacement costs.

### Precision Measurement Technology

The Hanatek Precision Thickness Gauge (FT3) measures thickness using test parameters configured to international standards or customer-specific requirements. Measurement accuracy is controlled through key factors including the measurement probe, applied pressure, dwell time, probe movement, and the flatness and parallelism of the measuring surfaces, ensuring highly repeatable results.

### Applications

The FT3 is designed to measure the thickness of a wide range of materials, including film, paper, cartonboard, foil, tissue, textiles, adhesive tapes, flexible packaging, flooring, geomembranes, and nonwoven materials. It supports numerous international standards, including ISO 3034, ISO 534, ISO 4593, ASTM D6988, ASTM D5199, ASTM F2251, ASTM D1777, ISO 5084, ISO 12625, and ISO 9073-2/EDANA.

### Available Configurations

The FT3 is available in multiple configurations to suit different testing requirements. The standard FT3 is factory configured for a single testing standard, while the FT3-V allows variable test pressure using external weights. The FT3V-LAB supports multiple standards with interchangeable measuring heads, and the FT3-U offers enhanced 0.01 µm resolution for ultra-high precision applications.

### Data & Reporting

The instrument features an intuitive touchscreen interface with programmable batch size, dwell time, and measuring speed. Automatic statistical analysis and time-stamped results simplify quality control, while RS232 connectivity allows easy data transfer and documentation.

overview:
### Hanatek Film Shrink Tester (FST)

Laboratory film shrink tester designed to measure the effect of heat on plastic films and determine their suitability for packaging applications.

### Film Shrinkage Measurement

The Hanatek Film Shrink Tester (FST) measures the effect of temperature on plastic films by determining their unrestrained or free shrinkage. As heat is applied, internal stresses created during film manufacturing are released, causing the material to contract. The amount of shrinkage depends on the film type, thickness, and sealing temperature.

### Why Film Shrinkage Matters

Film shrinkage is an important quality parameter for packaging applications. Blown plastic films are commonly heat-treated to seal and protect food and industrial products. Measuring shrinkage helps ensure the film performs as intended, as excessive shrinkage can distort the product or weaken the protective barrier.

### Packaging Quality Control

Testing the percentage of film shrinkage allows manufacturers to verify whether a film is suitable for a specific packaging application. It also helps determine the correct sealing temperature required for consistent packaging performance.

### Fast & Simple Testing

The FST is designed for quick laboratory testing with fast and accurate hotplate temperature control. The integrated backlit measuring scale makes it easy to determine the percentage of shrinkage, allowing results to be obtained within minutes.

### Applications

The Hanatek FST is suitable for evaluating the quality and thermal shrink characteristics of cast and blown plastic films used in packaging and other flexible plastic applications.

Measure Film Shrinkage

Determine the unrestrained shrinkage of plastic films under controlled heating conditions.

Improve Packaging Quality

Verify film suitability and establish the correct sealing temperature for packaging applications.

Quick Laboratory Testing

Fast hotplate control and an easy-to-read backlit scale provide simple and repeatable measurements.

shortDescription: Expand Your Creative Horizons
overview:
### ColorEdge CG3100X HDR

### Features for Working in 4K HDR

The ColorEdge CG3100X combines DCI 4K resolution, high brightness, high contrast, and HDR support for demanding creative workflows. Its 500 cd/m² brightness and 1800:1 contrast ratio help deliver clear highlights and detailed images, while HLG and PQ gamma curves support HDR production for broadcasting, films, and streamed content. Users can also configure camera log settings through ColorNavigator 7 to view log footage directly on the monitor during filming and post-production.

### DCI 4K Detail on a 30.5-Inch Screen

With a native resolution of 4096 × 2160 and a 17:9 aspect ratio, the CG3100X displays DCI 4K content at its intended resolution. The large 30.5-inch screen provides a detailed workspace for creating, editing, and reviewing 2D and 3D CGI, VFX, compositing, and color grading projects

### Color Precision

The monitor covers 99% of the DCI-P3 color gamut used in digital cinema and supports the BT.2020 standard for broadcast workflows. It also covers 97% of Adobe RGB, making it suitable for photography and other color-critical applications. Built-in color mode presets make it easy to switch between different project requirements.

### Smooth Gradations With 10-Bit Display

The CG3100X provides 10-bit simultaneous display from a 24-bit LUT, allowing it to display more than one billion colors. This high level of color processing helps produce smooth tonal transitions and reduces differences between adjacent colors. A compatible graphics board and software are required for 10-bit output.

### Advanced 3D LUT Color Processing

A built-in 3D LUT precisely maps colors using an RGB cubic table for accurate display reproduction. Through ColorNavigator 7, users can also apply film emulation using 3D LUT files to preview different film color characteristics during creative workflows.

### Automated Calibration With a Built-In Sensor

The integrated calibration sensor can automatically calibrate the monitor at designated times without requiring a separate third-party calibration device. The sensor swings onto the screen during calibration and retracts afterward, helping maintain color accuracy without taking up permanent screen space.

### Professional Color Management Software

ColorNavigator 7 provides a complete color management solution for calibrating and maintaining ColorEdge monitors. It offers preset color modes, simultaneous calibration of modes, automatic recalibration, and adjustable targets for brightness, white point, gamma, EOTF, and color gamut.

### Centralized Display Management

ColorNavigator Network allows studios and teams managing multiple ColorEdge monitors to control color settings remotely. Administrators can set color modes, schedule automatic self-calibration for monitors with built-in sensors, and manage display settings across networked workstations.

### Flexible Connectivity for Creative Workstations

The CG3100X supports USB Type-C, DisplayPort, and HDMI inputs for professional video workflows. DisplayPort and HDMI support DCI 4K at 60p, with 4:4:4 10-bit and 12-bit signal support, respectively. HDMI also supports Fixed Rate Link (FRL) technology for high-speed transmission of demanding high-resolution signals.

### One-Cable USB Type-C Connection

USB Type-C allows a compatible laptop or workstation to connect to the monitor with a single cable for video, USB hub access, and charging. With up to 94W power delivery, it helps reduce cable clutter while the built-in LAN port provides network connectivity for sharing creative files and assets.

### Comfortable, Quiet Studio Operation

The monitor uses a punched-metal rear design to support airflow and heat management, while its internal fan operates at approximately 20 dB for quiet operation. A bundled light-shielding hood helps reduce glare caused by ambient lighting and attaches magnetically without requiring separate components.

### Editing, Post Production & Audio Monitoring

The CG3100X includes a range of functions designed to support precise editing and post-production work. Pixel Inspection shows both source-input color information and the data displayed by the monitor, helping users verify technical settings and project parameters. A built-in headphone jack also provides direct audio output for conveniently checking audio content while working on video and post-production projects.

### HDR Monitoring With PQ and Sync Signal

PQ options allow users to check HDR content at different brightness levels by clipping or compressing the input signal to match the monitor's luminance capabilities. The Sync Signal function can automatically adjust brightness, gamma/EOTF, and color gamut according to metadata from the incoming signal, reducing the need for manual setting changes.

### Nearest Neighbor for Accurate Image Scaling

Nearest Neighbor interpolation can be selected when scaling or resampling images. When enlarging content, it aligns pixels with the closest neighboring position to help preserve their original color characteristics. Users can select the interpolation method that best suits their project directly from the monitor's on-screen controls.

### Check Luminance and Color Gamut

Luminance Warning highlights areas that would be clipped when PQ content is displayed at a specified brightness level. The monitor also includes BT.709 Out-of-Gamut Warning and BT.709 Clipping modes, allowing users to identify BT.2020 colors that cannot be reproduced within BT.709 and preview how wider-gamut content will appear in an HDTV environment.

### 4K Zoom and Safe Area Markers

The 4K Zoom function enlarges selected areas of the image for checking fine details and focus. Marker functions help position text and graphics accurately, while Safe Area Markers show the area where captions and other broadcast information should remain visible.

### Stable Image Display

The CG3100X is designed to maintain consistent image quality across the screen and during operation. Its gamma is factory-adjusted across the full RGB tonal range using a 24-bit LUT, helping deliver smooth gradations and accurate tones.

### Uniformity Across the Screen

EIZO's Digital Uniformity Equalizer (DUE) compensates for variations in brightness and chromaticity across the display. This helps maintain stable color reproduction and more consistent image quality from one area of the screen to another.

### AI-Based Temperature Correction

Temperature changes can affect the brightness, color, and gradation characteristics of an LCD display. The CG3100X uses an internal temperature sensor and AI-based estimation technology to detect temperature-change patterns and adjust display characteristics in real time for greater stability.

### Stable Color in Just 3 Minutes

While conventional monitors may require 30 minutes or more for their display characteristics to stabilize, the CG3100X reaches stable brightness, chromaticity, and tone characteristics in approximately three minutes after startup, according to EIZO's internal testing.

### Verified With a Factory Report

Every CG3100X includes a factory report showing measurement results recorded during production. The report includes measurements for uniformity, gamma, gamut coverage, and color temperature, providing verification of the monitor's display accuracy.

### Professional Quality & Certification

The CG3100X is backed by a 5-year manufacturer's warranty covering all components, including the LCD panel, with usage limited to 30,000 hours. EIZO also guarantees the product against bright sub-pixels for six months from the purchase date. The monitor is recognized by Fogra as a Class A FograCert Softproof Monitor. When used within a FograCert Softproofing System, it supports predictable and consistent softproofing for designers, print specifiers, and print producers.

Professional HDR Accuracy

Delivers DCI 4K resolution with 500 cd/m² brightness, 1800:1 contrast, HLG and PQ gamma support, and advanced HDR monitoring tools for demanding video production and post-production workflows.

Precise Color Management

name: Laray Viscometer Automated
shortDescription: Automated viscosity measurement system designed for precise rheology testing of highly viscous materials and printing inks.
overview:
### Designed for Accurate Viscosity Testing

The IGT Laray Viscometer Automated is developed to measure the viscosity of highly viscous materials, including varnishes, paste printing inks, and heavy oils. It evaluates the internal friction of liquids in motion, helping users accurately study rheological behavior for quality control and formulation analysis.
 

### Automated Rheology Calculation System

The system calculates shear rate from rod fall time and shear stress from applied weights, automatically generating graphs through its built-in calculation software. This allows users to determine viscosity behavior for both Newtonian liquids and Bingham plastics while identifying important values such as yield stress.
 

### Simple Testing with Built-In Software

The viscometer features an Android-based interface designed for intuitive operation and fast testing. During operation, the sample fills the gap between the rod and cup, while sensors automatically measure the rod’s falling speed based on the applied weight. Test data can then be reviewed and transferred directly to a PC using USB.
 

### Reliable Standardized Measurement Process

The falling rod testing method follows internationally recognized standards including ISO 12644 and DIN 53222 for rheological testing of paste inks and related materials. The system ensures highly repeatable results, making it suitable for laboratories requiring consistent viscosity measurement across multiple material types.
 

Automated Viscosity Analysis

Automatically calculates shear rate, shear stress, and viscosity through integrated software.

Precise Controlled Testing

Measures rod drop time across a 100 mm distance using weights from 50–1000 g in 50 g increments.

Temperature Controlled Testing

Rod and collar can be temperature controlled for highly accurate and repeatable rheology measurements.

### Purpose-Built for Orange Juice Color Evaluation

The Ci7520 is specially designed for accurate orange juice color measurement and grading, making it a USDA-approved solution for this application. When paired with X-Rite Color iQC software, it helps measure color values accurately and supports grading based on established industry standards. It also features an integrated magnetic test tube holder for easier sample handling while minimizing contamination during measurement.

### Accurate Measurement for Liquid Sample Testing

The Ci7520 operates in reflectance mode to deliver precise color measurement for orange juice and other liquid samples. Its built-in video preview helps ensure the correct measurement area is selected, while Color iQC software stores measurement images to maintain a complete audit trail and deliver verified, traceable results.

### Approved for Multiple Orange Juice Grading Applications

The Ci7520 is approved by the USDA for measuring and grading multiple orange juice categories, including frozen concentrated orange juice (FCOJ), canned concentrated orange juice (CCOJ), concentrated orange juice for manufacturing (COJFM), pasteurized orange juice (POJ), canned single strength orange juice (CSSOJ), and orange juice from concentrate (OJFC).

### Consistent Performance with Industry Compliance

Designed for reliable quality control, the Ci7520 ensures strong color consistency with 0.15 ΔE* inter-instrument agreement and 0.03 ΔE* repeatability. It also offers automated software-driven setup to reduce configuration errors and supports industry standards including CIE No.15, ASTM D1003, and ISO 7724/1 for dependable measurement performance across different environments.

USDA-Approved Color Grading

The Ci7520 is approved for orange juice color grading, delivering accurate and consistent measurement results based on USDA standards.

Accurate Liquid Sample Testing

Its reflectance measurement mode, integrated test tube holder, and video preview help ensure precise testing while reducing contamination risk.

Reliable Quality Control Performance

Automated setup, strong measurement consistency, and industry-standard compliance help maintain dependable quality control across every test.

name: P Series
shortDescription: High-Precision Multi-Stage Dispensing System for Industrial Production
overview:
### P-SERIES

### Multi-Valve Dispensing System

The P-Series solution is available in 32, 48, 72 or 96 multi-stage dispensing valves. It uses a patented centre point dispensing system that allows dispensing into containers of any size. Each valve is operated individually through a pneumatic cylinder system. The design removes rotating mechanical parts and motors to improve operational efficiency. This makes the system suitable for controlled industrial dispensing environments.
 

### Precision Weight-Controlled Dispensing

A high-precision electronic scale controls the weight of components during dispensing. The system communicates real-time weight data to the IMAESTRO software. This self-calibrating software adjusts dispensing parameters automatically for accuracy. It ensures consistent formulation results across production cycles. The system is designed for high-speed and precise material handling.
 

### Production Control and Traceability

Production and traceability are managed using barcode and QR-code systems. These systems are supported through smart devices using the IMAESTRO Mobile App. This enables structured tracking of production batches and materials. It improves visibility and control across operations. It also supports simplified production monitoring in industrial environments.

overview:
### MA-T12: Fully Characterize Complex Material Finishes

The MA-T12 is designed to deliver a high level of accuracy for evaluating effect and complex materials. Its 12 spectral measurement angles, combined with a color-calibrated camera, allow detailed characterization of both effect finishes and complex surface-structured materials. It also supports digital material modeling through SVBRDF (Spatially Varying Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function), helping create a consistent digital workflow that improves control over product appearance across the supply chain.

### The Most Advanced Multi-Angle Spectrophotometer

With an on-board color-calibrated RGB camera for imaging, the MA-T12 enables fast and accurate evaluation of color, sparkle, coarseness, and texture in complex finishes. It delivers high levels of repeatability and reproducibility, ensuring reliable results. When used with EFX QC, it becomes the preferred solution for defining strict color standards.

### Quick Identification of Non-Compliant Products

The MA-T12 features modern touchscreen navigation, live camera preview during measurement, and on-screen pass/fail indicators to quickly identify non-compliant products. It includes a centrally located aperture with positioning pins for stable measurements, along with automatic internal calibration to help reduce the risk of inaccurate readings.

### From Design Concept to Quality Control in One Device

When paired with PANTORA, the MA-T12 allows industrial designers to digitize complex material finishes during early concept and design stages using a handheld device that captures accurate color and appearance data for use in PLM software. The same device can then be used across the supply chain to ensure production stays within tolerance, and in final inspection to measure and capture all aspects of finished goods or vehicles.

### Best-in-Class Global Service and Support

With more than 60 years of experience, X-Rite has been helping customers master color quality across industries. Backed by global service centers and 40+ certified service partners, the support ecosystem includes technical assistance, ISO certification, Service Care Plans, training, and more. Whether it’s troubleshooting issues, improving workflows, or staying up to date with the latest technology, the service and support teams provide reliable and prompt assistance to keep operations running smoothly.

eXact 2 Plus includes all features of eXact 2 and supports measurement on both polarized and non-polarized substrates. Like the rest of the eXact 2 range, it comes with Mantis™, Digital Loupe, an intuitive touchscreen interface, and non-contact measurement capability.

### Specialized Measurement for Color-Critical Applications

Designed for ink manufacturers and printers working on color-sensitive jobs, the eXact 2 Plus includes advanced measurement functions such as opacity, metamerism, color strength, and paper quality evaluation.

### Fast Multi-Condition Scanning in a Single Measurement

The eXact 2 Plus allows easy switching between spot and scan modes using integrated wheels and patch recognition technology, improving measurement speed by up to 17%. It supports simultaneous measurement of M0 (UV included/ISO 13655:2017), M1 (D50/ISO 13655:2017), M2 (UV excluded/ISO 13655:2017), and M3 (Polarization/ISO 13655:2017) in a single workflow.

### Complete Ink and Print Workflow Solution

The device enables fast collection and visualization of color data, making it easier to access the required information when needed. It also includes on-screen QC and QA tools, simplified ink workflows, onboard Wi-Fi, and the ability to switch between polarized and non-polarized measurement modes for greater flexibility across substrates.

### Global Service and Reliable Support

With over 60 years of experience, X-Rite provides global support through more than 40 certified service partners. Services include technical assistance, ISO certification, Service Care Plans, training, and workflow optimization support to ensure minimal downtime and consistent performance.

Available in Three Models for Different Substrates

eXact 2 is available in three models to support different measurement needs: eXact 2 is designed for paper, eXact 2 Xp is used for film, poly, and foil, while eXact 2 Plus is built to handle all ink, print, and packaging substrates.

Full Access to X-Rite Link Device Dashboard

With X-Rite Link software, users get real-time access to device health and service history. It also allows remote updates for firmware, color libraries, and standards across an entire device fleet through a centralized dashboard.

Complete Warranty and Protection Coverage

All eXact 2 models come with two years of ISO:9001 compliant NetProfiler verification along with comprehensive protection. This includes accidental damage coverage and a loaner device through a Service Care Plan, where applicable by region.

In today’s competitive environment, accurately communicating and consistently achieving color and advanced effect finishes is essential. EFX QC is a specialized software solution designed to provide effective tools for managing effect finishes across complex materials used in different industries.

overview:
### Applications

Tempo Elite Color 2 is developed for sheetfed offset printing of commercial and packaging jobs where precise spot colours, including Pantone® shades, are required. The inks can be used individually or mixed to reproduce a wide range of custom colours. They are suitable for coated papers, matt and semi-matt coated papers, uncoated pigmented papers, recycled papers, and all types of board.

### Print Performance

The series offers a stable ink and water balance for easy press operation and is compatible with dampening systems both with and without alcohol. It provides high colour intensity, allowing lower ink consumption, along with quick setting, final oxidative drying, good gloss, excellent over-printability, lamination performance, and reliable rub resistance. The inks also remain stable on the rollers during extended production runs and overnight in the ink duct.

### Production Benefits

Designed for efficient sheetfed offset production, Tempo Elite Color 2 supports high-speed press performance while maintaining consistent print quality. Its stable press behaviour helps reduce production interruptions and ensures dependable results across commercial and packaging print applications requiring specific colour shades.

Consistent Colour Reproduction

Stable Press Performance

Broad Substrate Compatibility

name: ColorXRA G3 Glass Reflectance Spectrophotometer
shortDescription: For Reflectance Measurement on Glass Coatings
overview:
### Evaluate Color and Effectiveness of Glass Coating

Since glass is non-scattering, conventional measurement devices with direct illumination cannot provide accurate color data. The ColorXRA G3 measures from 330 nm to 1,000 nm with 1 nm optical resolution. In the lab, the device can be mounted on a stand to measure a glass pane laying on a sample support. To measure inline, the ColorXRA G3 can be mounted on a traversing beam above the pane to measure low-e glass and below the pane for the measurement of sun protection coatings.

-

### <0.1 dE*

Repeatibility on Calibration Mirror

-

### ≤0.3 dL*, da*, db*

Inter-Instrument Agreement

-

### > 1 second

Repetition Time

### Illuminates Both the UV and Visible Range

The ColorXRA G3 is a compact multi-angle spectrophotometer that measures from 330 nm to 1,000 nm with 1 nm optical resolution. It is mounted 10 mm from the glass pane and captures spectral data as well as color in reflectance on non-scattering samples at 3 different angles to qualify even multi silver layer coatings.

### Evaluate Color Consistency From Multiple Viewing Angles

The ColorXRA G3 uses a Xenon flash lamp to take measurements every second on non-scattering products such as coated glass using three geometries simultaneously at +15°: -15°, +45°: -45° and +60°: -60°. The ±15° measurement gives the same readings as in the laboratory with a sphere geometry measurement. The ±45° and the ±60° measurements show color change from different observer angles.

Precise Inline Color Measurement

The 1 nm resolution spectra data from 330 nm to 1,000 nm provide reliable information to control the coating process.

Short-Term Stability and Long-Term Accuracy

Uses real dual beam measurement and automatic wavelength calibration. Only requires external calibration every 4 weeks for maximum uptime.

Operates in Harsh Production Environments

Built with durability in mind, the ColorXRA G3 is rugged enough to endure busy labs and production lines without compromising measurement accuracy.
keyFeatures: Captures non-contact specular color reflectance measurements at 3 angles to detect coating errors
Mounted on a traversing beam to capture measurements in cross direction

name: ColorXRA 45 Pulp
shortDescription: For Measuring Pulp Inline
overview:
### Measures Paper Pulp to Warn of Early Color Shifts

In paper production, color and OBA information is first available at the pulp stage. While the readings are not the same as on finished paper, a color shift in the pulp is an indication that there will be a color shift in the wet paper and final product. The ColorXRA 45 Pulp is a compact, 45:0 inline spectrophotometer to measure color, whiteness, and brightness in thick pulp.

-

### 45:0

Device Geometry

-

### 330-730 nm

Spectral Range

-

### ≤ 0.3 dL*, da*, db*

Inter-Instrument Agreement

### Monitor and Evaluate Pulp Color and Brightness

Designed specifically to meet the needs of pulp manufacturing, the ColorXRA 45 Pulp spectrophotometer is mounted in a stainless steel housing and measures inline, directly into the thick pulp (concentration of 3% to 5%) through a bypass system. This device can measure color, whiteness and optical brightness to identify shifts before they impact the final product.

### Reduce Raw Material and Dye Usage

When blending two lines of raw material, such as dark and light, to a constant level, color and brightness can shift. The ColorXRA 45 Pulp monitors this during production to control the addition of waste and visualize the homogeneity of the pulp after each dye addition to ensure optimum dye consumption without significantly changing the color of the total pulp for increased product quality.

### Make Objective Pass / Fail Decisions

The ColorXRA 45 Pulp delivers excellent short-term stability due to its use of real dual beam measurement, and its automatic wavelength calibration ensures exceptional measurement accuracy and long-term stability. It is a must-have color measurement instrument to make objective color assessment for pulp manufacturing and is the ideal complement to ESWin QC software, the ColorXRA 45 Lab, and the ColorXRA 45 Inline for a complete measurement system for paper machines.

Capture Spectral Data With and Without OBAs

With a broad spectral range from 330 nm to 730 nm with a 1 nm resolution, this device delivers excellent color data for both visible and UV spectrums.

Enjoy Maximum Instrument Uptime

Automatic wavelength calibration ensures exceptional measurement accuracy and long-term stability. External calibration is only necessary every 4 weeks.

Make Clear Pass / Fail Decisions

When used with ESWin QC software, delivers clear pass/fail calculations and an easy-to-understand display of results for fast, accurate decision making.

name: Patented FLEXCEL NX Process
shortDescription: Patented FLEXCEL NX Process - Professional color and process control solution.
overview:
### Patented FLEXCEL NX Process

For Consistent and Predictable Flexographic Plate Production

Request A Quote
FREE PRODUCT CONSULTING -->

### Advanced Technology for Reliable Plate Production

The FLEXCEL NX Process is built around Miraclon’s fully integrated FLEXCEL NX Solution, designed to improve consistency and efficiency in flexographic plate production. At the core of this technology is a patented lamination process that creates a more controlled and predictable plate-making workflow, helping printers achieve reliable color consistency during production.

### Patented Lamination for Precise Plate Imaging

A key part of the FLEXCEL NX Process is its lamination technology, which removes oxygen during the UV exposure stage. This allows the film mask to stay in close contact with the plate surface, ensuring accurate 1:1 reproduction from the original digital file directly onto the plate while creating the foundation for highly predictable plate production.
 

### Flat-Top Dot Technology for Better Print Stability

The FLEXCEL NX Process creates flat-top dot structures that solve common limitations found in traditional digital flexo plate production. Unlike conventional dot structures that can create inconsistent ink transfer, flat-top dots improve print stability and help maintain more reliable color control throughout the printing process.

### Longer Plate Life with Reduced Surface Wear

Traditional digital flexo plates often create bullet-shaped dots that are more vulnerable to wear during printing. The flat-top dot structure distributes ink load more evenly across the surface, reducing stress at contact points and improving durability, even when printing at higher resolutions.

### Improved Durability for High-Volume Production

By reducing surface wear and improving ink transfer consistency, FLEXCEL NX plates can perform significantly longer during production. Printers commonly report plate life lasting two to five times longer compared to traditional plate structures, helping improve production efficiency and reduce replacement frequency.

Eliminates oxygen during exposure for more stable and predictable plate production.

Flat-Top Dot Structure

Creates more consistent ink transfer while improving print stability and color control.

Extended Plate Durability

Reduces surface wear and helps plates last two to five times longer in production.

name: Farnsworth Munsell 100 Hue Test
shortDescription: For Color Vision and Perception Evaluation
overview:
### Test Color Vision and Perception Accuracy

Since color perception varies from person to person, it is important for professionals involved in color evaluation to understand how accurately they see color. The Farnsworth Munsell 100 Hue Test is a proven method used to measure an individual’s ability to differentiate between color variations, making it especially valuable for color-critical industries. The test is designed to be performed under standardized daylight conditions such as those provided by X-Rite SpectraLight QC and Judge LED light booths.

### Trusted Global Standard for Over 60 Years

Used by governments and industries worldwide for more than 60 years, the test is recognized as a global standard for evaluating and ranking color acuity. It consists of four trays containing 85 removable color reference caps, each representing incremental hue variations across the visible spectrum. A participant’s color vision aptitude is determined by their ability to arrange these caps in the correct hue sequence.

### Reliable Evaluation for Color-Critical Roles

The Farnsworth Munsell 100 Hue Test helps identify the type and degree of color deficiency while providing a complete analysis of color vision for in-house teams and field staff involved in color-sensitive work. It can also serve as an independent reference point for validating the accuracy of other color vision tests, helping organizations maintain confidence in color-related operations.

Helps identify the type and degree of color vision deficiency by evaluating an individual’s ability to accurately distinguish subtle hue variations.

Trusted Industry Standard

The CG2700X covers 99% of the Adobe RGB color space and 98% of DCI-P3, supports the BT.2020 broadcast standard, and covers nearly the entire ISO-coated and US web-coated CMYK color spaces used in printing. Its built-in 3D LUT enables precise RGB color mapping, while ColorNavigator 7 provides professional calibration and color-management controls, including color emulation for previewing different color characteristics.

### 10-Bit Display & Smooth Gradations

The monitor supports 10-bit simultaneous display from a 16-bit LUT, allowing it to reproduce more than one billion colors when used with compatible software and graphics hardware. This helps create smoother gradations and reduce visible banding between adjacent tones, while factory gamma adjustment measures R, G, and B gamma values across the full 0–1023 range and uses the LUT to select appropriate tones for accurate reproduction.

### HDR, Broadcast & Cinema Workflows

With 500 cd/m² brightness, the CG2700X supports HLG and PQ gamma curves for HDR video production and includes preset modes for DCI-P3, BT.709, BT.2020, PQ DCI-P3, PQ BT.2100, and HLG BT.2100 workflows. Its 1450:1 typical contrast ratio supports deeper black reproduction in line with DCI requirements, while a retardation film helps maintain tone depth when viewing the display from an angle.

### DCI 4K Cropping & Image Scaling

The DCI 4K Cropping function allows the monitor to accept a 4096 × 2160 DCI 4K signal and crop it to the panel's native 3840 × 2160 resolution, with three cropping options available for selecting the displayed area. Nearest Neighbor interpolation provides another scaling option that preserves pixel color information when enlarging images, while the standard interpolation method can be used when smoother transitions are preferred.

### Post-Production Monitoring Tools

Using the DisplayPort or HDMI inputs, the CS2740 supports 10-bit simultaneous display from a 16-bit LUT and can display more than one billion colors from a 278-trillion-color palette. This helps produce smoother color gradations and more subtle transitions, although compatible graphics hardware and software are required for 10-bit output. HDMI connections also require equipment that supports DeepColor.

ColorNavigator 7 performs hardware calibration by working directly with the monitor's LUT, providing more precise adjustment and smooth gradation compared with software-based calibration. For workflows that require HDR monitoring, EIZO offers optional HLG and PQ gamma curves for the CS2740. These curves are designed to reproduce HDR content with a tonal response closer to how the human eye perceives real-world images.

Each CS2740 is factory-adjusted by measuring the red, green, and blue gamma values across 0–1023 and using its 16-bit LUT to select the appropriate 1024 tones. EIZO's Digital Uniformity Equalizer (DUE) also corrects brightness and chromaticity variations across the screen, helping maintain consistent image quality from one area of the display to another.

### Comfortable Viewing for Long Sessions

The IPS non-glare panel helps reduce reflections, while the monitor's dimming technology minimizes flicker for a more comfortable viewing experience. Its 178° horizontal and vertical viewing angles also allow multiple people to view the screen with minimal changes in color or contrast. HDMI input supports I/P conversion for converting interlaced video signals into progressive signals.

USB Type-C lets you send video and USB signals while supplying up to 60W of power to a compatible notebook or other device through a single cable. The CS2740 features electrostatic switches on the front bezel for seamless access to monitor settings and a built-in carrying handle for easier repositioning. Its ergonomic stand provides 155 mm of height adjustment, tilt from 35° upward to 5° downward, 344° swivel, and 90° pivot for portrait orientation, with a quick-release mechanism for removing the display from the stand. An optional magnetic light-shielding hood is also available to help reduce glare from ambient lighting.

### Sustainable Product Development

EIZO states that ColorEdge monitors are designed with recycled materials and low-impact components while maintaining the performance required for creative work. The monitors are optimized for energy efficiency; EIZO collects and recycles used products, and all production sites at its headquarters in Japan operate using 100% renewable energy.

The CS2740 comes with a five-year manufacturer's warranty covering all components, including the LCD panel, with usage limited to 30,000 hours. EIZO also guarantees the monitor will be free from bright sub-pixels for six months from the date of purchase. With 350 cd/m² brightness, 1000:1 contrast, 10 ms gray-to-gray response, and 178° viewing angles, the CS2740 is designed for detailed creative work. name: IGT FlexoProofer
shortDescription: Advanced Flexographic Proofing System Designed for Accurate and Reproducible Color Matching
overview:
### Precision Proofing Built for Accurate Color Reproduction

The IGT FlexoProofer is an advanced printing device developed to produce accurate and highly reproducible color proofs on specific substrates. Its strong correlation with commercial printing presses allows operators to predict print output more accurately while reducing the possibility of color mismatches and production dropouts during live printing processes.
 

### Intelligent Printing System with Advanced Control

The system combines an engraved anilox roller with doctoring technology, a photopolymer printing form section, and a dedicated substrate mounting sector to produce high-quality prints based on preset profiles. A powerful computer manages all movement controls precisely, while the touchscreen interface allows operators to easily create, store, and adjust print profiles as required.
 

### Advanced Mechanical Design for Stable Performance

The FlexoProofer uses a kiss-print printing force principle where pressure between the anilox and printing sectors is accurately controlled through sensors. Its open-chamber doctoring system enables precise ink dosing while preventing ink overflow toward the edges of the anilox roll, helping maintain cleaner operation and improving print consistency during repeated proofing cycles.
 

### Flexible Configuration and Profile-Based Operation

The machine features an advanced clamping system that allows photopolymer printing forms to be mounted and replaced easily, with optional compressible cliché tape support when required. The substrate section is secured with clamps for quick loading and removal, while all key parameters including speed, printing force, and pre-inking revolutions can be saved as reusable printing profiles for repeatable production workflows.
 

### High Accuracy Results with Efficient Cleaning and Workflow

The IGT FlexoProofer delivers highly reproducible prints with print deviations kept below Delta E 1, allowing close correlation with production presses and minimizing downtime caused by incorrect color matching. Both the inking and printing sections include dedicated cleaning functionality, allowing faster maintenance while ensuring reliable long-term operation across different substrates and ink types.

Supports printing speeds from 0.2 to 1.2 m/s with automatic pressure control through sensor-assisted print operation.

overview:
### Wide Format Printability Testing

The F1-100 is a special version of the F1 printability tester developed with a wider 100 mm print width for applications where standard 40 mm width is not sufficient. It is commonly used in industries such as electronics where wider print samples allow better appraisal of printing quality.
 

### Multi-Ink and Multi-Substrate Compatibility

The tester is designed for use with solvent-based inks, UV inks, and water-based inks across a wide range of substrates. It produces colour strips that can be used for colour measurement, colour matching systems, density measurements, print quality testing, and evaluation of properties such as wear resistance, adhesion, gloss, ink transfer, and chemical resistance.
 

### Controlled Printing Performance

The system combines an inking section with engraved anilox roller and doctor blade along with a printing section that includes a printing form and impression cylinder. Printing speed is adjustable from 0.2 to 1.5 m/s, while both anilox force and printing force can be independently set between 10 and 500 N for controlled print simulation.
 

### Flexible Printing Configuration

It supports flexo and gravure mode selection, maximum substrate thickness of 4 mm, printing width of 100 mm, printing length of 200 mm on second print, two engraved disc inking cycles, up to 9 anilox revolutions, and up to 20 photopolymer cylinder revolutions.
 

### Components and System Design

The tester supports multiple engraved disc configurations for flexo and gravure applications, including copper, chromium plated, and ceramic laser engraved versions. It uses a 60° trailing doctor blade with 6–7 N pressure and supports solid or screened printing forms in rubber and photopolymer with interchangeable substrate carrier configuration.
 

### General Specifications

shortDescription: 24.1” Color Management Monitor for Digital Media Creation
overview:
### EIZO ColorEdge CS2400R

 

### Streamlined USB Type-C Connection

The ColorEdge CS2400R uses USB Type-C to carry video and USB signals while supplying up to 70W of power to a connected notebook or tablet. This single-cable setup helps keep creative workspaces organized, while DisplayPort and HDMI provide additional connection options for different devices.

### 100% sRGB Color for Digital Media

The CS2400R covers 100% of the sRGB color space, making it well suited to web images, digital illustrations, mobile content, and other work intended for sRGB environments. Its 24.1-inch IPS panel provides a 1920 × 1200 resolution in a 16:10 aspect ratio, with 94 ppi, a 518.4 × 324.0 mm viewable area, 0.270 × 0.270 mm pixel pitch, 300 cd/m² brightness, a 1000:1 contrast ratio, 14 ms gray-to-gray response time, and 178° horizontal and vertical viewing angles.

### Smooth 10-Bit Display

The CS2400R supports 10-bit simultaneous display from a 16-bit LUT, allowing it to reproduce more than 1.07 billion colors from a palette of 278 trillion. This helps create smoother gradations and more precise color transitions. A compatible graphics board and software are required for 10-bit output, while HDMI 10-bit display requires a Deep Color-compatible device.

### Hardware Calibration & Easy Screen-to-Print Matching

ColorNavigator 7 enables hardware calibration using compatible external calibration sensors, directly adjusting the monitor's LUT for accurate and consistent color reproduction. The CS2400R also supports Quick Color Match, which simplifies screen-to-print matching by automatically adjusting the monitor, retouching software, and printer settings for an easier photo-printing workflow.

### Factory-Adjusted Color & Uniformity

EIZO individually adjusts the CS2400R at the factory to achieve accurate and consistent color reproduction. Its 16-bit LUT uses measured gamma values across the tonal range to select appropriate tones, while the Digital Uniformity Equalizer corrects variations in brightness and chromaticity across the screen for more uniform image quality.

### Flexible Inputs & USB Connectivity

The monitor provides USB Type-C with DisplayPort Alt Mode and HDCP 2.3, DisplayPort with HDCP 2.3, and HDMI with Deep Color and HDCP 2.3. Its USB hub includes a 5Gbps Type-C upstream connection with 70W power delivery, a 5Gbps Type-B upstream port, two 5Gbps Type-A downstream ports, and two USB 2.0 Type-A ports. USB Type-C and DisplayPort support 26–76 kHz horizontal and 23–61 Hz vertical scanning, while HDMI supports 15–76 kHz and 23–61 Hz.

### Practical Display Controls

The CS2400R includes User, sRGB, and Calibration (CAL) modes for different workflows, along with controls for color adjustment, input color format, YUV color matrix, input range, I/P conversion, picture expansion, menu rotation, power saving, input and mode skipping, custom keys, information display, key lock, and DUE priority. The on-screen menu is available in English, German, French, Italian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Swedish, and Traditional Chinese.

### Comfortable, Flexible Design

The monitor features a sleek cabinet with rounded edges, a non-intrusive stand base, a built-in carrying handle, and side-accessible USB ports. Its ergonomic stand provides 155 mm of height adjustment, 35° upward and 5° downward tilt, 344° swivel, and 90° pivot adjustment, with quick-release functionality and VESA 100 × 100 mm compatibility. An optional magnetic light-shielding hood is also available to help reduce reflections.

### Factory Report & Verified Accuracy

Every CS2400R comes with a Factory Report showing measured results for characteristics including screen uniformity, gamma, color gamut coverage, and color temperature. This provides a record of the monitor's factory-adjusted performance and helps verify its color reproduction.

### Sustainable Packaging

The CS2400R uses packaging designed to reduce plastic and styrofoam, with molded pulp made from recycled cardboard and newspaper. Its supplied cables are also packed in cardboard rather than plastic bags, reducing unnecessary packaging materials.

### Power, Size & Operating Conditions

The CS2400R operates on AC 100–240 V at 50/60 Hz, with typical power consumption of 15 W, maximum power consumption of 134 W, and standby consumption of 0.30 W or less. It measures approximately 554.4 × 396–551 × 245 mm with its stand and weighs 8.1 kg, or 5.1 kg without the stand. The monitor is designed for operation from 0–35°C with 20–80% relative humidity.

### Built for Long-Term Use

The CS2400R comes with a 5-year warranty covering all components, including the LCD panel, with a usage limit of 30,000 hours. EIZO also guarantees zero bright sub-pixels for six months from the date of purchase. The monitor carries certifications and standards including CB, CE, UKCA, TUV/GS, cTUVus, FCC-B, CAN ICES (B), VCCI-B, RCM, RoHS, WEEE, and TUV/Ergonomics.

### Supplied Accessories & Compatibility

The supplied accessories include a 2 m USB Type-C cable, 2 m HDMI cable, AC power cord, 2 m USB Type-A to Type-B cable, setup guide, Factory Report, and warranty card. Compatible accessories include EX5, EX4, and EX3 calibration tools, CH2410 and CH2400 monitor hoods, the LA-011-W arm, OPAVM-P100 mounting equipment, and other compatible EIZO cables and cleaning accessories.

overview:
### Multi-Strip Offset Proofing for Accurate Color Comparison

The IGT C1x3 is a printability tester designed to produce color prints using conventional and UV offset inks. The system can print three separate 15 mm strips positioned side by side with only 1 mm spacing, allowing users to print a target color alongside plus and minus tolerance samples on a single substrate. It can also produce prints with a width of 35 mm when required.
 

### Reliable Color Testing Across Multiple Applications

The device produces color strips with a known ink layer thickness for use in color measurement systems, color matching, visual evaluation, density measurement, coverage testing, scratch resistance, flexibility testing, adhesion, gloss evaluation, light fastness, chemical resistance testing, and general print quality analysis. It helps reduce the need for costly press-side color testing while maintaining consistent results.
 

### Versatile Printing on Multiple Materials and Industries

The C1x3 prints on coated and uncoated substrates including paper, board, plastic film, laminate, cellophane, metal, and other packaging materials. It is commonly used across printing ink production, paper and board manufacturing, printing operations, plastics, packaging industries, coatings, lacquers, resins, and raw material testing environments.
 

### Automated Printing System with Fast Ink Distribution

The machine combines an inking section with two aluminium drums and a top roller along with a printing section that uses a removable printing disc. Ink distribution takes approximately 30 seconds while the printing disc is inked in 15 seconds. Once printing force is applied, the print cycle runs automatically and the printing disc lifts automatically after completion for substrate removal and cleaning.
 

### Flexible Printing with Tube and Can Compatibility

The printing force can be adjusted in 19 steps between 100 and 1000 N depending on application requirements. The system can also print directly on cans, hoses, and tubes using a variable diameter impression cylinder, making it suitable for applications in beverage and cosmetics packaging where direct cylindrical printing is required.

name: Orange Proofer

overview:
### Efficient Offset Ink Testing

The IGT Orange Proofer is a dedicated printability tester developed for producing colour prints using conventional and UV offset inks. Designed as a cost-effective solution, it provides reliable proofing performance for businesses that require accurate testing without the need for heavy-duty continuous operation. For high-volume production environments, the C1 tester remains the recommended alternative.
 

### Built for Consistent Performance

The system is engineered to deliver repeatable and reproducible results with simple operation. It features a printing unit with an impression cylinder and printing disc covered with a rubber blanket for conventional inks, while the manually adjustable printing force ranges from 100 N to 900 N. Operating at a speed of 0.3 m/s, it ensures dependable proofing performance for everyday testing requirements.
 

### Practical Application in Ink Verification

The Orange Proofer is widely used in printer ink kitchens where quick colour verification is essential before production begins. It allows operators to produce colour strips for checking ink quality directly on the substrate intended for the printing press, making it an efficient way to confirm ink matching before full production runs. For higher measurement accuracy, the IGT Ink Pipette can also be used alongside the system.
 

### Simple and Fast Operating Workflow

The process begins by applying ink to the rubber top roller of the inking unit, where the ink is distributed in just 30 seconds. The printing disc is then inked for 15 seconds, mounted onto the printing shaft, and positioned above the prepared substrate carrier. Once printing force is applied, the system automatically produces the print, creating a quick and efficient proofing workflow.
 

### Designed for Reliable Daily Operation

The Orange Proofer combines inking and printing within a single compact system. It includes two aluminium drums with a rubber top roller, driven independently for easier cleaning, while supporting multiple printing disc options including rubber, rubber blanket, UV-curing variants, and aluminium discs. The machine weighs 25 kg, measures 32 × 62 × 35 cm, and operates on 115/230 V – 50/60 Hz, making it easy to move and suitable for a wide range of substrates and ink types.

name: Drying Time Tester
shortDescription: Precise drying and absorption testing for printed materials
overview:
### Designed for Accurate Drying Analysis

The Drying Time Tester is developed to determine the drying time and absorption behaviour of inks printed on materials such as paper, carton, plastic films, and metal foils. It also allows testing of set-off characteristics on coated or laminated substrates for reliable print quality evaluation.

### Controlled Multi-Station Testing

The system is equipped with 8 test stations, positioned at equal distances for consistent testing conditions. Each station includes a 25 mm pressure application roller and matching counter roller, allowing printed or laminated samples to be tested against reference papers or identical substrate surfaces.
 

### Reliable Drying Time Measurement

During testing, wet ink produces a 25 mm set-off trace on the counter paper while moving through the station at a controlled speed. The drying time is determined by measuring the length and density of the set-off trace, with adjustable testing speeds ranging from 10 to 200 mm/h for different evaluation requirements.
 

### Flexible Testing Applications

For more critical absorption testing, samples can also be tested against non-absorbing counter materials such as PVC, cellophane, or metal laminated paper, removing the influence of standard counter paper. The system also supports testing with full-length press samples cut to 40 mm width in lengths such as 500, 700, or 1000 mm.

### Consistent Result Evaluation

Drying performance is evaluated by measuring the counter print transfer length until no further ink transfer occurs. The drying time is calculated by dividing the transfer length by the selected speed, while drying time curves can be created by measuring print density at 10 mm intervals across the sample.
 

Drying Time Measurement

Measures drying behaviour by tracking set-off transfer length and density.

Multi-Substrate Testing

Compatible with paper, carton, plastic, metal foils, and laminated materials.

Advanced Evaluation Control

name: DLS Color Viewing Light v7
shortDescription: LED-based color viewing system for accurate color matching and consistent visual quality control
overview:
### DLS Color Viewing Light v7

### Reliable Daily Color Matching

The DLS Color Viewing Light v7 provides controlled lighting for everyday color matching and visual quality checks. It is suitable for flat samples such as paper, fabrics and coatings, as well as 3D samples made from different materials. Multiple illuminants can also be used to identify metamerism during color comparison.

### Advanced LED Viewing Technology

The system uses JUST LED technology with switchable D50, D65 and UV-A illumination. D50 represents 5000 K noon daylight, while D65 represents 6500 K average daylight from the northern sky. UV-A can be used to detect optical brighteners and switched off when required. A CAD-based prismatic diffuser provides uniform, glare-free illumination, while the asymmetrical light design is intended for viewing from one fixed position with minimal reflection and glare.

### Flexible Lighting Control

D50 and D65 illumination can be continuously dimmed without visible color shifts, making the system suitable for soft proofing applications. Two memory presets allow commonly used viewing conditions to be recalled quickly, while different illuminant sequences can be programmed for specific inspection routines. The USB interface also allows connection to a PC for dimming control and soft proofing integration.

### Consistent Viewing Performance

The DLS v7 provides exact D50 and D65 color conditions and meets the relevant requirements of ISO 3664:2009 for D50 and ISO 3668 for D65. It delivers a CRI of ≥95, with a metamerism index of MIvis ≤0.8 and MIuv ≤0.6. UV-Only operation is also available, including the option to switch off UV content for assessments according to the older ISO 3664 requirements.

### Long-Life Maintenance-Free Design

The LED system provides more than 50,000 operating hours without regular tube replacement. Instant-on functionality means there is no warm-up period, while the long-life LED design keeps maintenance requirements low for daily color evaluation.

### Available Sizes & Applications

The DLS Color Viewing Light v7 is available in S, L, XL and XXL versions for different sample sizes and viewing requirements. Illumination areas range from 64 × 36 cm on the S model to 119 × 90 cm on the XXL model, with the L and XL versions providing 125 × 54 cm and 155 × 54 cm respectively. Depending on the model, features include 2D print and 3D object viewing, metamerism assessment, large-format viewing, USB, dimming, programmable light sequences, UV on/off, D50, D65 and UV-Only options.

Standardized Color Evaluation

D50, D65 and UV-A illumination provide controlled viewing conditions for color matching, proofing and visual quality checks.

Precise Viewing Performance

Uniform illumination, high CRI and low metamerism values support consistent visual assessment across different materials.

Flexible Long-Term Operation

Multiple sizes, programmable lighting, continuous dimming and a 50,000+ hour LED lifespan make the system suitable for varied daily color evaluation needs.

name: DLS Color Control Center
shortDescription: Walk-in LED standard light booth for controlled, large-area color assessment
overview:
### DLS Color Control Center

### Large-Area Color Assessment

The DLS Color Control Center is a walk-in LED standard light booth designed for controlled visual color testing across large samples and a wide range of materials. It is suitable for flat samples such as paper, fabrics and coatings, as well as 3D samples made from different materials. Multiple illuminants support reliable metamerism detection, while the booth’s asymmetrical lighting design provides fixed, one-side viewing with little reflection and glare. The system is designed to meet the requirements of ISO 3668, DIN 6173-2 and VDA 280 Part 8B/8C for standardized color assessment and quality control.

### Walk-In Booth Construction

The booth measures 325 × 235 × 280 cm (W/D/H) and features a fully enclosed ceiling cover for controlled viewing conditions. Its cubicle housing uses an easy-to-assemble anodized aluminum profile construction with 80 mm square profiles. Light-proof, neutral-gray curtains help maintain a consistent viewing environment, while the removable enclosure can be configured with sliding doors, fixed aluminum sheet walls or opaque curtains. The DLS multiLight luminaire is dimmable and can achieve standard-compliant illuminance at 1 m above the floor.

### Flexible Illuminant Options

The DLS Color Control Center can be configured with three or five light types depending on the model. D50 follows ISO 3664:2009 with its UV component switchable on or off and provides more than 2,000 lux at 1 m above the floor. D65 follows ISO 3668:2014, also with switchable UV content and more than 2,000 lux. UV-A provides UV-only illumination, while ALT1 and ALT2 use CIE LED B1-B3 sources covering 2733–4103K with Ra=80. The LED system simulates standard illuminants for different assessment conditions, including D50 at 5000K for noon daylight, D65 at 6500K for average northern-sky daylight, UV-A for UV-only assessment, and LED B1-B5 lighting conditions.

### Accurate Color & Light Control

The system provides precise, repeatable lighting for professional color evaluation. D50 and D65 offer a CRI of Ra ≥95, with exact 10° color targets of x=.3478 / y=.3595 for D50 and x=.3138 / y=.3309 for D65, each with a tolerance of ≤.002. The metamerism index is ≤0.8 for visible light (MIvis) and ≤0.6 for UV (MIuv). D50 and D65 can be steplessly dimmed, while multiple illuminants can be selected simultaneously. The UV component can be switched off for assessment according to older ISO 3664 requirements. The system also includes USB connectivity, two memory presets and a digital operating-hours meter for all illuminants. The DLS lighting technology is protected by U.S. Patent No. US 8,592,748 B2.

### Control System & Operation

The DLS Color Control Center uses a modern PLC control system that allows an unlimited number of lights to be controlled. A control box with manual buttons is installed on the cabinet, while the main external keypad operates the DLS multiLight 5-1700 v8 system. USB connection enables PC communication, and illuminants can be dimmed and programmed into different lighting sequences. The system has an approximate maximum power consumption of 4 kW and requires a 16A, 3-phase electrical connection, with an optional red CEE coupling or direct connection. Electrical installation on site is carried out by an in-house electrician

### Applications & Configurations

The DLS Color Control Center is designed for large and flat viewing samples, 3D objects, paper, fabrics, coatings and other materials where controlled color evaluation is required. Its multiple-light configuration makes it suitable for detecting metameric effects across up to three illuminants. The v7 configuration (Item 201835) provides D65, D50 and UV-A, with an illumination area and booth footprint of 325 × 235 cm. It includes USB, dimming, 2D large-format and 2D print assessment, light sequences, 3D object viewing, metamerism up to 3, UV on/off, D50 LED, D65 LED and UV ONLY. The v8 configuration (Item 201837) provides five illuminants — D65, D50, UV-A, ALT1 and ALT2 — with the same core capabilities and additional LED B1-B5 functionality. Both versions use the same 325 × 280 × 235 cm external dimensions. The U.S. versions maintain the same physical size at approximately 128 × 110 × 92.5 inches, with v7 offering three illuminants and v8 offering five.

Choose between three or five illuminants depending on the configuration, with D50, D65, UV-A and additional ALT lighting available for comparing colors under different conditions and identifying metameric effects.

name: DLS Virtual proofStation
shortDescription: LED color proofing station designed for modern softproof workflows from prepress to press
overview:
### DLS Virtual proofStation

### Modern Softproof Color Matching

The DLS Virtual proofStation is designed for reliable color matching throughout the workflow from prepress to press. It combines a dimmable and switchable D50/D65 LED luminaire with a monitor mount, pull-out keyboard and USB interface for softproofing applications. Alongside the standard Virtual proofStation, the range includes Side-by-Side configurations that allow multiple or large printed sheets to be viewed in parallel.

### Standardized LED Illumination

JUST LED technology is Fogra certified according to ISO 3664:2009 and protected by U.S. Patent No. 8,592,748 B2. D50 and D65 can be selected according to ISO 3664 and ISO 3668, with the UV component enabled or disabled for either illuminant to support new and old ISO requirements. UV-ONLY provides UV-A illumination for detecting optical brighteners. D50 represents noon daylight at 5000K, while D65 represents average daylight from the northern sky at 6500K.

### Consistent Viewing Conditions

The Virtual proofStation provides extremely homogeneous, glare-free and reflection-free illumination through its Fresnel-type prismatic lens and asymmetrical light design for viewing from one side at a fixed position. The complete viewing surface is finished in neutral, matt gray according to Munsell N7, while side walls can shield the viewing area from extraneous light. Illuminance is 2,000 lux according to the ISO standard, with a Color Rendering Index of Ra ≥95, exact 10° D50 coordinates of x=0.3478 / y=0.3595 and D65 coordinates of x=0.3138 / y=0.3309, each within ≤0.002 tolerance. The metamerism index is ≤0.8 in the visible range (MIvis) and ≤0.6 in the UV range (MIuv).

### Softproofing & Monitor Control

The station provides continuous dimming without color shifts and uses a USB interface for connection to a PC. Monitor calibration software can be used to match the brightness of the screen with the LED color proof light, supporting reliable softproofing workflows. A monitor mount and pull-out keyboard are included, while the illuminants can be programmed into different sequences for repeatable viewing conditions. The monitor and keyboard shown in the product presentation are not included as standard unless specified by the configuration.

### Long-Life LED Performance

The JUST LED system requires no preheating after switching on and provides more than 50,000 hours of operating life, approximately 20 times that of fluorescent lamps. Light output remains stable throughout the entire lifespan, and annual relamping is not required. The system can also switch off the UV component when assessment according to the older ISO 3664 standard is required, while multiple illuminants support effective metamerism detection.

### Applications & Configurations

The DLS Virtual proofStation supports flat samples such as paper, fabrics and coatings, particularly large and flat samples, plus softproofing with monitor-matched brightness. The DLS Virtual proofStation (Item 201459) has a 100 × 70 cm illumination area, 138.5 × 74.5 cm usable area and 145 × 221 × 116.5 cm outside dimensions, with asymmetrical light guidance, USB, dimming, 2D large-format, 2D print, softproofing, monitor mount, metamerism up to 3 illuminants, UV on/off, D50 LED, D65 LED and UV ONLY.

The Side-by-Side BASIC (Item 201487) has the same illumination and usable areas, 145 × 218 × 117 cm outside dimensions, plus programmable light sequences. The Side-by-Side XT (Item 201489) provides double 100 × 70 cm illumination and 138.5 × 74.5 cm usable areas, with the same outside dimensions as BASIC and features 2D large-format, 2D print, softproofing, light sequences, metamerism up to 3 illuminants, UV on/off, D50 LED, D65 LED and UV ONLY; it is available only as an extension to BASIC.

Reliable Softproofing

Dimmable D50 and D65 LED lighting, USB connectivity, monitor calibration support and a dedicated monitor mount provide controlled conditions for comparing digital and printed color during softproofing.

Flexible Viewing Formats

Choose the standard Virtual proofStation for individual viewing or a Side-by-Side configuration for parallel assessment of multiple or larger printed sheets, with the XT version providing two adjacent 100 × 70 cm illumination areas.

Controlled Color Assessment

ISO-compliant illumination, switchable UV, UV-ONLY, programmable light sequences, metamerism detection, and stable LED performance provide repeatable conditions for professional color matching.

name: DLS Duplex proofStation
shortDescription: Reflective and transmissive lighting for large-format colour assessment
overview:
### DLS Duplex proofStation

### Duplex Colour Assessment

The DLS Duplex proofStation combines LED-based colour proofing with a transmissive lighting unit and a cabinet for organised storage of prints and proofs. It provides standardised D50, D65 and UV-A lighting from above, plus D50 lighting from below, making it suitable for colour assessment of large-format, translucent prints and labels in the labelling and packaging industry. Reflective and transmissive lighting can be used separately, while a magnetic mounting rail on the rear wall holds prints in position.

### LED Illuminants & Controls

The station provides three LED-based illuminants: D50 according to ISO 3664, D65 according to ISO 3668 and UV-A. UV content can be enabled or disabled for either D50 or D65, while both illuminants offer continuous dimming. A USB interface and memory function for presets are also included, with different illuminant sequences programmable for repeatable assessment workflows.

### Transmissive Lighting Unit

The transmissive lighting unit provides uniform illumination with high luminous efficacy. It uses scratch-resistant crystal glass and a colour-neutral, anti-reflective plexiglass panel, with colour temperature infinitely adjustable from 2500 to 5500 K. Maximum luminance is approximately 1800 cd/m², and standard dimming is continuously adjustable from 0–100%.

### Illuminant Characteristics

The asymmetrical light design supports viewing from one side at a fixed viewing position with very little reflection and glare. D50 provides noon daylight at 5000 K, while D65 represents average daylight from the northern sky at 6500 K. UV-ONLY provides UV-A illumination, and the UV content can be switched off when assessment according to the old ISO 3664 is required.

### Features & Applications

The viewing area is back-lit for transmissive assessment, while the system supports USB connection to a PC, dimmable illuminants and programmable light sequences. It is designed for particularly large and flat viewing samples, including paper, fabrics and coatings, while its multiple illuminants support good detection of metamerism.

### Available Configurations

The DLS Duplex proofStation 6B (Item 203472) has a 140 × 100 cm illumination area and 140 × 100 cm transmissive lighting area, with a 160 × 130 cm usable area and outside dimensions of 160 × 230 × 146 cm. It has seven drawers, each measuring 149 × 4 × 122 cm, and requires 160 × 137 cm of floor space. Its special features include asymmetrical light guidance, USB, dimming, 2D large-format, 2D print, backlighting, light sequences, metamerism detection up to 3 illuminants, UV on/off, D50 LED, D65 LED and UV ONLY.

The DLS Duplex proofStation 7B (Item 203474) provides a 160 × 120 cm illumination and transmissive lighting area, 180 × 140 cm usable area and outside dimensions of 180 × 230 × 176 cm. Its seven drawers each measure 169 × 4 × 135 cm, with 180 × 150 cm required floor space, and it includes the same special features as the 6B version. Both configurations are available at a price on request.

Reflective & Transmissive Viewing

Use reflective and transmissive lighting separately to assess large-format translucent prints, labels and other flat samples with different viewing requirements.

Integrated Storage

The cabinet includes seven drawers for organised storage of proofs and plots, keeping samples accessible while maintaining a dedicated colour assessment workspace.

Large-Format Options

Choose between 6B and 7B configurations with different illumination, usable and transmissive areas to accommodate different large-format assessment requirements.
